feature.name: latest_completed_adjusted_close_simple_return
feature.definition: x_i = adjusted C[i] / adjusted C[i-1] - 1, defined for i >= 1, observed at close i

new_predictor.name: P4_expanding_ols_prev_return
new_predictor.formula: mu_i = alpha_i + beta_i * x_i where (alpha_i, beta_i) minimise sum over the mature pool of (y_j - alpha - beta x_j)^2
new_predictor.closed_form: beta = Cxy / M2x, alpha = ybar - beta * xbar with xbar, ybar pool means, M2x = sum (x_j - xbar)^2, Cxy = sum (x_j - xbar)(y_j - ybar)
new_predictor.stable_computation: running centered statistics updated per matured label (Welford form): n += 1; dx = x - xbar; xbar += dx / n; dy = y - ybar; ybar += dy / n; M2x += dx * (x - xbar); Cxy += dx * (y - ybar). No raw sum-of-squares differencing. ybar is also the global P1 statistic and must match stored P1 within 1e-15.

fallback_rules.n_pool < 2 or M2x <= n_pool * 1e-24: beta undefined -> beta = 0, mu = ybar (contemporaneous P1); count fallback_degenerate. 1e-24 is a pure numerical guard (pool sd of x below 1e-12, far below any return scale), not a tuned threshold

new_predictor.update_timing: statistics change only when a label matures (j = i-2 at close i); x_i enters only the emitted prediction, never the statistics until its own label matures at close i+2
new_predictor.no_regularization: ordinary least squares only; ridge/shrinkage/window would be new design choices
